paper_metadata.title: Voxtral
paper_metadata.abstract: We present Voxtral Mini and Voxtral Small, two multimodal audio chat models. Voxtral is trained to comprehend both spoken audio and text documents, achieving state-of-the-art performance across a diverse range of audio benchmarks, while preserving strong text capabilities. Voxtral Small outperforms a number of closed-source models, while being small enough to run locally. A 32K context window enables the model to handle audio files up to 40 minutes in duration and long multi-turn conversations. We also contribute three benchmarks for evaluating speech understanding models on knowledge and trivia. Both Voxtral models are released under Apache 2.0 license.

extraction_data.innovation: transcribemode: introduces a dedicated special token to signal transcription tasks, eliminating the need for a text prompt and reducing redundancy; Online DPO: adopts an online variant of Direct Preference Optimization where two candidate responses are sampled per example and ranked using a text-based reward model on the audio transcription, improving response quality over offline DPO; Audio-adapted SFT: converts existing text SFT data (including function calling) into synthetic audio via TTS to enable audio-only input scenarios; ASR question extraction: isolates audio excerpts from long-form ASR data containing questions answerable by general world knowledge, pairing them with text answers to address speech recognition's unambiguous task nature; Speech-synthesized benchmarks: creates speech-synthesized versions of GSM8K, TriviaQA, and MMLU by filtering verbalizable prompts, rewriting math/code/symbols into speech-friendly text, and synthesizing diverse single-speaker utterances for evaluation.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: Audio dataset with text transcriptions (pseudo-labeled via ASR if unavailable), balanced with text pretraining data
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning, preference alignment, Supervised discriminative fine-tuning for speech understanding and instruction following, Supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
extraction_data.extension: 4x downsampling MLP adapter layer to reduce audio sequence length from 50Hz to 12.5Hz
extraction_data.research_problem: Multimodal language modeling and speech understanding
extraction_data.application: Speech transcription, translation, speech QA, summarization, audio reasoning, text understanding
extraction_data.finetuning_data: real and synthetic data, Synthetic QA, summarization, and translation data from long-form audio transcripts; manually curated user requests, function calling datasets converted to audio via TTS, long-form ASR data, synthetic summarization and translation data, speech-synthesized benchmarks (GSM8K, TriviaQA, MMLU)
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: synthetic data, Mistral Large generates QA pairs, summarization, and translation data from long-form audio transcripts; multiple candidate pairs generated per segment and sampled; manually curated user requests used to mitigate overfitting, TTS conversion of text SFT data; synthetic summarization and translation data
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: text-based reward model on audio transcription
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Concatenation of audio and text embeddings passed through a 4x downsampling MLP adapter
extraction_data.benchmark_result: Surpasses GPT-4o mini Transcribe and Gemini 2.5 Flash across all speech translation tasks.; SOTA on English Short-Form and MCV; beats GPT-4o mini Audio on 3/7 speech understanding tasks; comparable to Mistral Small 3.1 on text benchmarks.
